per_claim.no_dataset_reason: I could not identify, and so could not verify, any public dataset of sunflower floret coordinates or parastichy crossing angles with a resolvable landing page or DOI. The portals I know well (GBIF, NCBI, Dryad, Zenodo, figshare) hold sunflower genomes, occurrence records and agronomic phenotyping data. None is a confirmed record of per-floret positions or spiral crossing angles. Naming one from memory would risk a fabricated identifier. The test needs a new capitulum image set with floret segmentation, or a floret-coordinate deposit from a phyllotaxis study.

per_claim.no_dataset_reason: I could not find and verify a public deposit of 3D red-cell shape reconstructions (holotomography or similar) that includes both isotonic and hypotonic conditions and has a landing page and DOI I can confirm. One search turned up only journal articles on red-cell holotomography and an unrelated organoid dataset. Two-dimensional smear images cannot give mean curvature. I am reporting null rather than naming an unverified identifier. The test could be run if a verified deposit of 3D RBC tomograms with osmotic conditions is identified.
